items.q: The only thing about it, we had Earl Hyman who is a Shakespeare actor.

ctx.x: We did get a chance to do these things -- Dick and I -- all of them, at one of the Overseas Press Club's jazz parties.
And it was with just Dick on piano, and they (inaudible) bit of it. The only thing about it, we had Earl Hyman who is a Shakespeare actor.
He was the declaiming all over the place --
